## 🚀 Quick Start & Installation

#### What you need

- [Obsidian.md](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fobsidian.md%2Fdownload) installed.
- **Git (optional):** Required only for the 'Lightweight' (Path B) or 'Full Clone' (Path C) install methods.

##### Pick your path

- **A: Direct Download (Easiest):** No command line needed.
- **B: Lightweight Clone (Recommended):** Best for most users.
- **C: Full Clone (For Contributors):** For developers who will update using Git.



>[!IMPORTANT]  
>Once installed via any path, future updates are handled by the in-vault **Vault Updater**.


---

#### Path A — Direct Download (Easiest)

1. **Get the Vault**
    - Go to the repository page: [github.com/BETO-GROUP/BETO.888](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FBETO-GROUP%2FBETO.888)
    - Click the green **< > Code** button, then **Download ZIP**.
    - Unzip the file. The folder will be named BETO.888-main.

2. **Open in Obsidian**    
    - In Obsidian, select **Open another vault** → **Open folder as vault**.
    - Choose the BETO.888-main folder you just unzipped.


> [!NOTE]  
> Future updates are handled directly from within the vault.

---

#### Path B — Lightweight Clone (Recommended)

**1. Create the Vault Folder**

- Run the command for your OS. This creates a BETO.888 folder ready for Obsidian.

**macOS / Linux:**
```shell
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/BETO-GROUP/BETO.888.git && cd BETO.888 && rm -rf .git
```
    
**Windows (Command Prompt):**
```shell
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/BETO-GROUP/BETO.888.git && cd BETO.888 && rmdir /s /q .git
```


**2. Open in Obsidian**

- In the app, go to **Open another vault** → **Open folder as vault** and select the BETO.888 folder.


> [!NOTE]  
> Future updates are handled directly from within the vault.

---

#### Path C — Full Clone (For Contributors)

Use this method **only if you plan to contribute changes back to the project** and need the full commit history.

> [!WARNING]  
> This is a very large download (**nearly 1GB**), with the .git history folder itself being over 600MB. This is not necessary for simply using the vault.

1. **Clone the Full Repository**
    - Open your terminal and run:


```shell
git clone https://github.com/BETO-GROUP/BETO.888
```
    
2. **Open in Obsidian**
    - In Obsidian, select **Open another vault** → **Open folder as vault**.
    - Choose the new BETO.888 folder.


> [!NOTE]  
> As a contributor, you should use the git pull command to get the latest updates.

----

###### That's it! The BETO.888 vault experience is ready, and your journey begins.

Welcome to **BETO.888**, the creative toolkit for building rich web applications directly inside your Obsidian notes. 

Instead of just writing documents, BETO.888 provides the power to construct, interactive tools. It uses a library of modular blocks to bypass complex setup, solving common frustrations like plugin bloat and slow startup times. It’s a sandboxed environment designed to enable a rapid, AI-accelerated workflow, allowing you to build the exact functionality you need.

Our mission is to provide the foundation for this next generation of creation, following a simple cycle: **Discover, Learn, Develop, Teach, Repeat.**

## 🤝 Contributing & Community

BETO.GROUP thrives on its community. Your participation and feedback are what fuel our evolution.

*   **Principle:** *Nullius in verba* — "Take nobody's word for it." We prove our commitment through action, and we value contributions over words.
*   **Join the Conversation:** The best place to connect, ask questions, and share your work is our **[Discord Server](https://discord.gg/6rDp4q4Y2B)**.
*   **Provide Feedback:** Found a bug? Have a brilliant idea? Share it in the `#feedback` channel on Discord. In line with our **Reciprocity Ethos**, valuable contributions are highly appreciated and may be recognized with community perks.
*   **Stay Updated:** To see the latest changes, check the [CHANGE LOG](CHANGE%20LOG.md) note.

*   **All Folks Aboard.** It is currently a one-person passion project, and as such, it is a perpetual "Work in Progress." Expect the occasional bug; they are part of the adventure.
